safeguards.name: Minimum Available Disk Space (1 GiB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Simulated disk space < 1 GiB throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

safeguards.name: Minimum Available RAM (150 MB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Simulated available RAM < 150 MB throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

safeguards.name: Disk / RAM Query Exception Handling
safeguards.simulatedScenario: statfs returning ENOENT or permission denied throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED (no optimistic pass)

safeguards.name: Per-Gate Log Buffer Cap (50 MB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Stream exceeding 50 MB triggers child termination and gate fail

safeguards.name: Git Worktree & HEAD Immutability Check
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Modifying working tree or advancing branch during run is detected and rejected

safeguards.name: Orphan Process Group Cleanup
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Killing gate process targets -child.pid so Vitest worker threads are also reaped

safeguards.name: Bounded Concurrency Semaphore
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Semaphore prevents more than 2 async child processes executing simultaneously

safeguards.name: SQLite Pipeline Sequential Dependency
safeguards.simulatedScenario: E5, E8, and E9 execute sequentially to eliminate SQLite SQLITE_BUSY write lock contention
